questions.subject: Finance
questions.question: Which of the following is a reason that HMB wants to hedge risk?
options: A) Monitoring costs
B) Bankruptcy costs
C) Transaction costs on oil derivatives
D) Costs in hiring experts to monitor the positions

questions.subject: Finance
questions.question: HMB has an inherent (1) position. They could hedge this position by (2).
options: (1) Short position in the oil price; (2) Short a collar on oil
(1) Long position in the oil price; (2) Long a collar on oil
(1) Short position in the oil price; (2) Short a call on oil
(1) Long position in the oil price; (2) Long a call on oil

questions.subject: Finance
questions.question: Which of the following strategy can be a hedge and is less costly than the original strategy 1 (limiting the maximum price they pay for oil with an exercise price of US$105)?
options: A) Short Collar with strike prices US$100 and US$105 per barrel
B) Short Forward
C) Long put with strike price of US$105 per barrel
D) Long call with strike price of US$100 per barrel

questions.subject: Finance
questions.question: HMB considers to use a 1-year forward contract to hedge his position. When the contract was entered, the forward price was US$110 per barrel. If 3-month later, the 1-year forward price is US$108 per barrel while the 9-month forward price is US$112 per barrel. What will be the value of HMB’s forward position then?
options: A) Zero
B) Positive
C) Negative
D) Unknown

questions.subject: Finance
questions.question:
HMB asked about the differences between the long forward contract on oil and a direct investment in oil.  Which of the following statements are true?
1. Initial value of a long forward contract is zero.
2. Long forward earns compensation for time value of money.
3. Long forward earns compensation for risk.
4. Arbitrage profit from forward is impossible with transaction costs.
5. Forward has less credit risk than futures.

questions.subject: Finance
questions.question: HMB expects to earn in total of HKD7.41 million (equivalent to USD950,000). Which of the following strategy cannot avoid a negative profit?
options: A) Long forward with forward price 110.25
B) Long call option with strike price 100
C) Long call option with strike price of 110
D) Long call option with strike price 110 and short put option with strike price 100

questions.subject: Finance
questions.question: Based on your answer in short question 6 (What should be the fair price of a 6-month currency forward?), what arbitrage can you take if the 6-month forward price is 1.3 $/euro?
options: A) Long the currency forward, borrow US dollar, lend euros
B) Long the currency forward, lend US dollar, borrow euros
C) Short the currency forward, borrow US dollar, lend euros
D) Short the currency forward, lend US dollar, borrow euros

questions.subject: Finance
questions.question:
HMB has scheduled to buy oil exactly 1 year from now. HMB is considering a strategy that would limit the maximum price they pay for oil (strategy 1). The exercise price in strategy 1 is US$105 per barrel.
(a) What is the unhedged cashflow per barrel? Draw the payoff diagram. (4 points)
(b) What is the hedged cashflow per barrel? Draw the payoff diagram. (4 points)

questions.subject: Finance
questions.question:
Eventually, HMB decides to use a collar to hedge its risk exposure to oil price risk (Strategy 2).  [...details about options and premiums...]
(a) What is the notional value for each option contract? (3 points)
(b) How many contracts should HMB buy? (2 points)
(c) Find out the cost of strategy 2 per barrel. (3 points)
(d) Draw the profit diagram of strategy 2 per barrel. (4 points)
(e) What is the oil price such that HMB can break-even on strategy 2? (4 points)
